achievements.name: Yasumizu
achievements.detail: Reach the mountain village of Yasumizu after your bike ride goes wrong.

achievements.name: The Mist
achievements.detail: Be in Yasumizu when the mist closes in and the Feast is announced.

achievements.name: The Feast
achievements.detail: Take part in the Feast of the Yomi-Purge, where wolves kill at night and humans vote by day.

achievements.name: Cast a Vote
achievements.detail: Join a daytime council and vote on who the village will hang.

achievements.name: Survive a Night
achievements.detail: Live through a night of the Feast and see the village the next morning.

achievements.name: The Loop
achievements.detail: Die in Yasumizu and return to an earlier day with what you learned still in mind.

achievements.name: First Key
achievements.detail: Obtain a Key, information from one point in the story that you can use at another.

achievements.name: Hidden Choice
achievements.detail: Spend a Key to take a choice that stayed locked on an earlier pass.

achievements.name: An Ending
achievements.detail: Follow a branch of the story through to an ending.

achievements.name: Humans Prevail
achievements.detail: See a Feast end with the humans victorious over the wolves.

achievements.name: Wolves Prevail
achievements.detail: See a Feast end with the wolves victorious.

achievements.name: Revelation Mode
achievements.detail: Clear the main endings and unlock Revelation Mode.
